canDo.en: I can build a persuasive argument using strong collocations and link contrasting ideas with although, despite, whereas and however.
canDo.bg: Мога да изградя убедителен аргумент със силни колокации и да свързвам противоположни идеи с although, despite, whereas и however.

body.en: Collocations are word partners that native speakers use automatically. They often don't match Bulgarian: we make (not "take") a decision — Bulgarian "вземам решение" pushes learners towards "take". Other key partners: raise concerns / raise an issue, meet / miss a deadline, take steps / take action, carry a risk, reach an agreement, pay attention. Using the right partner makes you sound fluent and persuasive; the wrong one is understood but marks you as a learner.
body.bg: Колокациите са думи, които носителите на езика съчетават автоматично. Често не съвпадат с българския: на английски make (а не "take") a decision — "вземам решение" подтиква към "take". Други важни съчетания: raise concerns / raise an issue (повдигам притеснения/въпрос), meet / miss a deadline (спазвам/изпускам срок), take steps / take action (предприемам мерки/действия), carry a risk (крие риск), reach an agreement (постигам споразумение), pay attention (обръщам внимание). Правилното съчетание те прави да звучиш свободно и убедително; грешното се разбира, но издава, че учиш езика.

examples: We need to make a decision by Friday.

The team worked late to meet the deadline.
The government must take steps to reduce pollution.

body.en: These all show contrast, but their grammar is different. "Although" + a full clause (subject + verb): Although it was expensive, we bought it. "Despite" / "In spite of" + a noun or -ing form, never a clause: Despite the cost… / Despite being expensive… (not "Despite it was expensive"). "Whereas" compares two different facts in one sentence: Sales rose in the north, whereas they fell in the south. "However" links two separate sentences and usually takes a comma: It was expensive. However, it was worth it. Bulgarian "въпреки че" and "въпреки" mirror although/despite, so think: is a verb coming?
body.bg: Всички тези думи изразяват контраст, но граматиката им е различна. "Although" + цяло изречение (подлог + глагол): Although it was expensive, we bought it. "Despite" / "In spite of" + съществително или -ing форма, никога изречение: Despite the cost… / Despite being expensive… (не "Despite it was expensive"). "Whereas" сравнява два различни факта в едно изречение: Sales rose in the north, whereas they fell in the south. "However" свързва две отделни изречения и обикновено е със запетая: It was expensive. However, it was worth it. Българските "въпреки че" и "въпреки" съответстват на although/despite, така че се питай: следва ли глагол?

texts.title: Why we should move to a four-day week
paragraphs: Although many managers are sceptical, I believe the time has come to make a decision about the four-day week. We have discussed it for over a year without reaching an agreement. Several staff members have raised concerns about burnout, and our sickness rate has doubled in two years.
Despite working fewer hours, teams in the pilot scheme met every deadline last quarter. They also made fewer mistakes, whereas the five-day teams reported more overtime and lower morale.
Of course, the change carries some risk. Customer service needs cover on Fridays, and we would have to take steps to protect it. However, these are practical problems, not reasons to do nothing.

Some colleagues argue that clients expect us to be available five days a week. In practice, however, very few clients contact us on Fridays, and urgent requests can be handled by a small rota. If we fail to act, we may lose talented people to competitors who already offer flexible schedules. I am therefore asking the board to approve a six-month trial starting in January.

items.prompt: Complete: "We can't wait any longer — we need to ___ a decision today."

explanation.en: In English you make a decision (you can also reach or come to one). "Do", "give" and "put" don't combine with "decision". Bulgarian "вземам решение" also pushes learners towards "take a decision": it exists in British English, but "make" is far more common and is the safe choice.
explanation.bg: На английски make a decision (може и reach / come to a decision). "Do", "give" и "put" не се съчетават с "decision". Българското "вземам решение" подтиква и към "take a decision": среща се в британския английски, но "make" е много по-често и е сигурният избор.

hints.en: Same verb as in "make a mistake" and "make progress".
hints.bg: Същият глагол като в "make a mistake" и "make progress".

items.prompt: Several parents have ___ concerns about the new school timetable.

explanation.en: We raise concerns (= bring them up for discussion). "Risen" is from "rise", which has no object (prices rise), so it can't take "concerns". "Lifted" is physical. "Concerns have grown" is possible, but not "parents have grown concerns".
explanation.bg: Казваме raise concerns (= повдигам притеснения). "Risen" е от "rise", който няма допълнение (prices rise), затова не може да е с "concerns". "Lifted" е физическо вдигане. "Concerns have grown" е възможно, но не и "parents have grown concerns".

hints.en: You need a verb that takes an object: someone does it TO concerns.
hints.bg: Трябва ти глагол с допълнение: някой го прави С притесненията.

items.prompt: The report was late because we didn't ___ the deadline.

explanation.en: The collocation is "meet a deadline" (finish on time); the opposite is "miss a deadline". "Catch" goes with buses and trains, not deadlines.
explanation.bg: Колокацията е "meet a deadline" (спазвам срок); обратното е "miss a deadline". "Catch" се използва за автобуси и влакове, не за срокове.

items.sentence: Despite ___ (have) very little experience, she got the job.

explanation.en: "Despite" is a preposition, so it is followed by a noun or an -ing form, not a full clause: Despite having… With a clause you'd need "Although she had very little experience…".
explanation.bg: "Despite" е предлог, затова след него идва съществително или -ing форма, а не цяло изречение: Despite having… С изречение би трябвало "Although she had very little experience…".

hints.en: After a preposition, verbs take the -ing form.
hints.bg: След предлог глаголът е в -ing форма.

objective.bg: Да избереш между although и despite.

items.prompt: Which sentence about the walk in the rain is correct?
options: Despite it was raining, we went for a walk.
Although the rain, we went for a walk.
Despite of the rain, we went for a walk.
Although it was raining, we went for a walk.

explanation.en: "Although" + subject + verb: Although it was raining. "Despite" needs a noun (despite the rain) and is never followed by "of" — that's "in spite of". Bulgarian "въпреки че валеше" = although; "въпреки дъжда" = despite.
explanation.bg: "Although" + подлог + глагол: Although it was raining. "Despite" изисква съществително (despite the rain) и никога не е с "of" — това е "in spite of". "Въпреки че валеше" = although; "въпреки дъжда" = despite.

hints.en: Which word can be followed by a subject and a verb?
hints.bg: След коя дума може да има подлог и глагол?

accept: Rents rose sharply, whereas salaries stayed the same.

explanation.en: "Whereas" joins two clauses and highlights a difference between them. Each side keeps its own subject and verb, and a comma usually comes before "whereas".
explanation.bg: "Whereas" свързва две изречения и подчертава разлика между тях. Всяка част запазва своя подлог и глагол, а пред "whereas" обикновено има запетая.

hints.en: Make two short clauses and put "whereas" between them.
hints.bg: Направи две кратки изречения и сложи "whereas" между тях.

items.sentence: The city council has promised to ___ steps to improve air quality.

explanation.en: "Take steps" = take action to deal with a problem. Here "take" is right — compare "make a decision". There's no logic to it; collocations simply have to be learned as chunks.
explanation.bg: "Take steps" = предприемам мерки. Тук "take" е правилно — сравни с "make a decision". Няма логика, колокациите просто се учат като цели фрази.

objective.en: Identify evidence in a persuasive text.
objective.bg: Да откриеш доказателство в убеждаващ текст.

items.prompt: What evidence does the writer give that the four-day week works?
options: Teams in the pilot met all their deadlines and made fewer mistakes.

explanation.en: The second paragraph: "teams in the pilot scheme met every deadline last quarter. They also made fewer mistakes". The doubled sickness rate is a problem, not evidence that the scheme works; competitors are mentioned as a risk.
explanation.bg: Вторият абзац: "teams in the pilot scheme met every deadline last quarter. They also made fewer mistakes". Удвоените болнични са проблем, а не доказателство, че схемата работи; конкурентите се споменават като риск.

hints.en: Read the paragraph about the pilot scheme.

objective.en: Understand how a writer handles counter-arguments.
objective.bg: Да разбереш как авторът се справя с контрааргументи.

items.prompt: In the third paragraph, what is the function of "However, these are practical problems, not reasons to do nothing"?
options: It admits that the plan is too risky.
It introduces a new argument against the four-day week.
It accepts a weakness but argues it should not stop the plan.
It summarises the views of the sceptical managers.

explanation.en: The writer first concedes a risk (Friday cover), then uses "However" to say this is manageable. Conceding and then countering is a classic persuasive technique.
explanation.bg: Авторът първо признава риск (покритието в петък), а после с "However" казва, че той е преодолим. Признаването и последващото опровергаване е класическа техника за убеждаване.

hints.en: What comes before "However" — a strength or a weakness?
hints.bg: Какво стои преди "However" — силна или слаба страна?

items.sentence: The writer asks the board to approve a ___ trial.

explanation.en: The last sentence: "I am therefore asking the board to approve a six-month trial starting in January." Note the hyphen: a number + noun used as an adjective takes a hyphen and no plural -s (a six-month trial, not "six-months trial").
explanation.bg: Последното изречение: "I am therefore asking the board to approve a six-month trial starting in January." Обърни внимание на тирето: число + съществително, използвано като прилагателно, е с тире и без -s за множествено число (a six-month trial, не "six-months trial").
